question: Bhimbetka caves are situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhimbetka caves are located in** **Madhya Pradesh, India.**
 
• These caves are known for their prehistoric rock paintings and have been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• **The paintings in the caves depict the life of early humans, their daily activities, and their relationship with animals.**
 
• These caves were discovered by V.S. Wakankar in 1957and have since then been a major tourist attraction.
 
• **Rajasthan, Haryana, and Gujarat **are also home to several ancient caves and rock paintings, but Bhimbetka caves are specifically located in Madhya Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Haryana is home to the Surajkund lake, which is surrounded by several ancient temples and caves, including the famous Bhuteshwar temple and Karna lake caves.**
 
• Gujarat is home to the famous Junagadh caves, which are known for their intricate rock-cut architecture and sculptures.
 
• **​These caves were built during the reign of Emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BCE.**
